newsitem.title: UK: Williams sees earnings dilution in year.
newsitem.headline: Williams sees earnings dilution in year.

text.p: Williams Holdings Plc said on Friday its proposed 1.3 billion stg proposed takeover of Chubb Security Plc would result in "modest dilution" of earnings per share in the first 12 months before reorganisation costs.
But the company said it expected the merger would boost earnings in the second year.

"As the financial benefits of the acquisition continue to be progressively realised, it is anticipated that additional enhancement in earnings per share will be achieved in the third year of ownership with further benefits thereafter," the company said in a statement.
Williams said it expected to see annual benefits of 40 million stg flowing from the merger by the end of December 1998.

It said within this total it saw integration benefits of some 26 million stg and operational performance improvements of seven million, and another seven million stg in profits on additional sales. But the expected cost of achieving these benefits was expected to amount to some 30 million stg.

It said it could get savings from the combination in purchasing and distribution, consolidation of manufacturing locations, overall administrative economies of scale "and the application of Williams' management disciplines."
